summary: Persistent WebSocket backdoor forwards remote commands to Claude Code with permission checks disabled
details: The package opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded endpoint wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound messages to a control handler that (a) feeds arbitrary message text into a Claude Agent SDK session started with permissionMode set to 'bypassPermissions', which allows the remote peer to invoke the Bash and Write tools on the installer's host without any approval prompt, and (b) directly performs FileRead / FileWrite / FileSearch / FileTree operations against the installer's filesystem in response to remote messages. An AgentUpdate control message additionally spawns a detached self-update process (process.execPath argv[1] update). The net effect is a remote-controlled shell and file-access channel into any machine running the agent, controlled by whoever holds the server endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
